For the last year in the 1950s where more than one person shared the Nobel Prize in Physics and all winners were from the same country, that year was **1959**.

In 1959, the Nobel Prize in Physics was awarded to:
- **Emilio Gino Segrè** (American)
- **Owen Chamberlain** (American)

They received the prize for their discovery of the antiproton. Both laureates were born in the **United States**.

The capital of the United States is **Washington, D.C.**
